explication:
<explanation>
1. Project Type and Purpose  
   - This is a monolithic full-stack web application built with SvelteKit that provides a self-hosted AI-powered search experience.  
   - It integrates with a Postgres database for persistence, a SearXNG search microservice for web searches, and an LLM provider (Ollama or OpenAI) for generating responses.  
   - It supports multi-user authentication (AuthJS/OIDC) and is deployed via Docker Compose or Kubernetes.  

2. Top-Level Components  
   a. Client (Browser)  
      - Renders the SvelteKit front end (HTML/CSS/JS).  
      - Initiates API calls (tRPC) for data, search, and AI interactions.  
   b. SvelteKit Server  
      - Routes and SSR (src/routes, +layout, +page).  
      - tRPC API layer (src/lib/trpc/router.ts).  
      - AuthJS/OIDC middleware (src/lib/auth.ts, hooks.server.ts).  
      - Metrics endpoint for Prometheus (src/lib/metrics).  
      - OG image generator (src/lib/og).  
   c. Database Service  
      - Postgres (prisma/schema, migrations).  
      - Used by Prisma client calls in server and by the migrate container.  
   d. Search Microservice  
      - SearXNG (deploy/docker/searxng or external URL via SEARXNG_URL).  
      - Returns JSON search results.  
   e. LLM Provider  
      - Ollama or OpenAI endpoints (configurable via LLM_MODE, OLLAMA_URL or OPENAI_BASE_URL + API key).  
      - Performs embedding, summarization, follow-ups, etc.  
   f. Authentication Provider  
      - External OIDC IdP (optional).  
   g. Deployment & Ops  
      - Docker Compose stack (deploy/docker/compose.yml).  
      - Kubernetes Helm chart (deploy/kubernetes/perplexideez).  
      - Dockerfiles for app and migration.  

3. Relationships & Data Flows  
   - Client → SvelteKit Server: page requests, tRPC calls.  
   - Server ↔ Postgres: CRUD (users, chats, favorites, sharing links).  
   - Server → SearXNG: web search requests.  
   - Server → LLM Provider: prompt completions, embeddings, image/video search.  
   - Server ↔ Auth/OIDC: user login, sign-up, token exchange.  
   - Prometheus → Server: scrapes metrics endpoint.  
   - CI/CD (GitHub Actions) → Builds & pushes Docker images, publishes Helm chart.  

4. Architectural Patterns & Principles  
   - Monolithic application with microservice dependencies (Search, LLM, Auth).  
   - Layered separation:  
     • Presentation (SvelteKit UI)  
     • API layer (tRPC routers)  
     • Business logic (src/lib/ai, src/lib/utils)  
     • Persistence (Prisma + Postgres)  
   - Stateless pods/containers: all state in Postgres or external services.  
   - Configuration via 12-factor environment variables.  
   - Metrics-driven observability (Prometheus).  

5. Diagram Tailoring Guidelines  
   - Enclose “Client” in a browser icon or rectangle.  
   - Group SvelteKit Server components (Routes, tRPC, Auth, OG, Metrics) in one box labeled “App Service.”  
   - Place Postgres in a cylinder.  
   - Represent SearXNG and LLM endpoints as separate service boxes.  
   - If showing deployment, group services into Docker Compose or Kubernetes namespaces/pods.  
   - Show the GitHub Actions workflow triggering builds & Helm publishes.  

6. Visual Notation Recommendations  
   - Use clear labels on all boxes.  
   - Draw directional arrows for each data flow:  
     • Browser → App Service → DB, Search, LLM, Auth.  
     • Prometheus → `/metrics` endpoint.  
   - Apply color coding or shapes:  
     • Blue for internal components (App Service, Prisma).  
     • Orange for data stores (Postgres).  
     • Green for external services (SearXNG, LLM provider, OIDC).  
     • Gray for CI/CD pipeline.  
   - Optionally, use containers or swimlanes to show runtime boundaries (Docker vs. Kubernetes).  

7. Detail & Completeness  
   - Include the migration container (runs `prisma migrate`) as a separate box linked to Postgres under deployment.  
   - Depict both Dockerfiles (app and migrate) under “Build Artifacts.”  
   - Annotate protocols (HTTP, gRPC/tRPC, WebSockets if used).  
   - Label environment variables groups (DATABASE_URL, SEARXNG_URL, LLM_MODE, OIDC_*) near their corresponding components.  

By following the above analysis, you can draft a comprehensive system design diagram that clearly conveys the architecture of Perplexideez—highlighting how the SvelteKit monolith orchestrates data and AI services within a containerized deployment environment.  
</explanation>
